title: APS formal handoff cycle novice UX fixture
scope: Single-machine novice UX coverage for first formal handoff, post-publish formal-notification plus optional APS Live routing, receiver check Drive, missing-information return, sender revise, and sender close before true two-machine UAT.
boundary: This fixture locks acceptable first-screen wording, actionability judgement, and failure samples. It is not real human UAT, not true two-machine evidence, not real Drive timing proof, and not an external notification proof.

qcContract.scenarioBoundary: Static formal-handoff UX scenarios only; not final APS acceptance and not complete cross-machine UAT.
qcContract.noviceBoundary: Use only as an evaluator fixture. Do not give acceptableFirstScreen, forbidden items, passCondition, or behindTheScenes text to a tested novice user or tested AI role as expected-route material.
qcContract.cognitiveLoadGuard: Keep this fixture separate from operation smoke, browser proof, observer judgement, and final UAT; the tested role receives only a natural task goal.
stopGates: Stop if fixture answers or observer criteria reach the tested role.
Stop if a stage runs longer than 30 minutes without a checkpoint.
Stop if APS Live should be opened but no valid browser page is captured.
Stop if blocked Drive, CLI, APS Live, or browser evidence is hidden in a pass result.
qcContract.lastSessionFailureGuard: S246, S247, and S248 were local or mixed same-machine defect-discovery evidence; this fixture must not be used to rename those sessions as complete uncoached novice UAT.

cases.userInput: 把目前工作交給 jay，請他檢查能否接手下一步。
cases.localState: Current APS cooperation directory has confirmed peers and a confirmed shared baseline. No active handoff ticket exists.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 我會先整理交接確認卡，不會直接寫入共用 Drive。這張確認卡會列出收件人 jay、共同目標、本方已完成、請 jay 做的事、對方不應做的事、真源位置、開工條件與風險。若缺資料，我最多問三個關鍵問題；你確認內容和 topic 後，我才會寫入 APS。
cases.behindTheScenes: Run Check APS / peers read-only, verify confirmed shared baseline and confirmed receiver, build a strict handoff body with source pointers and receiver start condition, then wait for explicit user confirmation before publish.
forbidden: 請你自己輸入 npx aps publish
cases.passCondition: A novice sees a confirmation card path and knows nothing is written until they confirm; after publish, the user sees both paths: formal receiver check Drive, and optional APS Live through each side saying Check APS in their own already-connected project folder. The AI owns the technical publish step and never tells the sender to share a local file:// Live URL.

cases.matrixRow: 收件方 check Drive：可開工
cases.localState: A pending handoff packet from adam to jay is complete: shared goal, sender task, receiver task, source pointers, start condition, and risks are present and readable.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 📬 有一份 adam 交來的工作。先看總覽：主題、版本、來源、建議狀態是可開工。重點是 adam 已完成初稿整理，請你檢查下一步；真源和開工條件可讀。本機對接檢查通過後，我會建議你開始處理，或在你確認後標記已讀。
cases.behindTheScenes: Run check-drive / inbox, read the packet body, run context check as background only, verify current project, latest version, source readability, receiver start condition, and no sender-local-only path.
forbidden: 把 context 當成覆蓋 packet 的真相
cases.passCondition: The receiver sees summary, actionability judgement, local fit check, and a clear next step before any ack is written.

cases.matrixRow: 收件方 check Drive：資料不足
cases.localState: A pending handoff packet exists but source pointers or receiver start condition are missing, stale, or sender-local-only.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: ⚠️ 這份交接暫時不可開工。缺口是：真源位置不可讀、開工條件未清楚，或版本與目前本機狀態不一致。我會先列出缺甚麼、為何影響回應、你現在能否先做局部工作，然後建議向 adam 發出補交需求；原交接不應被說成完成。
cases.behindTheScenes: Keep the original handoff pending unless the user explicitly chooses a returned/declined state; prepare a missing-information request with missing items, reason, and whether partial work is possible.
forbidden: 要求收件方自己找發送方本機檔案
cases.passCondition: The receiver can explain exactly what is missing and send a bounded return request without closing the original work line.

cases.matrixRow: 發送方收到退回後 revise
cases.userInput: 對方說資料不足，要我補真源和開工條件。
cases.localState: The sender owns the original outbox packet and has a returned / missing-information reason from the receiver.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 我會優先修訂同一條交接線，不重發一堆新包。先讀對方退回原因，再整理補交內容：新增可讀真源、明確開工條件、說明這一版補了甚麼。你確認後，我才用 revise 寫入新版本，並給你一段可轉發通知。
cases.behindTheScenes: Read status and decline reason, prepare revise body against the original packet id, preserve topic / items unless explicitly changed, and avoid close / withdraw unless requested and justified.
forbidden: 把退回視為對方已完成
改成另一個 APS 合作目錄
cases.passCondition: The sender revises the same handoff line with clear versioned additions and notification text.

cases.localState: The user is the original sender; the receiver has consumed, replied, declined with resolution, or otherwise confirmed the line is finished.
cases.acceptableFirstScreen: 我會先確認你是原發送方，並檢查這個 packet 是否在你的 outbox，以及對方是否已有回覆、退回或完成紀錄。符合條件時，我會建議 close，並要求你確認收結理由；close 後這條交接線不再列為待辦。
cases.behindTheScenes: Check packet ownership, latest version, receiver ack / reply / decline status, and close reason. Refuse receiver-side close of someone else's packet.
forbidden: 收件方 close 對方 packet
cases.passCondition: Only the original sender closes their own outbox packet after resolution, with a specific reason.
